consequence.statement: Existing NodePool objects remain stored as v1beta1 after the upgrade until rewritten; the operator must run a storage version migration (re-write all objects) and update status.storedVersions of the nodepools.karpenter.sh CRD before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Run the storage version migration: re-write all NodePool objects so they are stored at v1, and update status.storedVersions of the nodepools.karpenter.sh CRD so v1beta1 is no longer listed, before upgrading to a release that removes v1beta1.
